knownSemantics: EKS Kubernetes version end-of-standard-support. Clusters on the affected version will be auto-upgraded after the deadline if not upgraded manually.
notes: If the notification mentions extended support pricing only (no forced upgrade yet), consider COST_IMPLICATION.

knownSemantics: AWS is patching the Fargate OS. Pods will be evicted and rescheduled. Workloads with single replicas or blocking PodDisruptionBudgets may experience downtime.
notes: Check for standalone pods, single-replica Deployments, and blocking PDBs (see devops-agent-skill/SKILL.md's E3.2 checks).

knownSemantics: Amazon MSK security patching. Standard brokers will be restarted one at a time. Clusters with topics at replication-factor=min-ISR may lose availability during restart.
notes: Check offline-partition history and replication-factor notices (see devops-agent-skill/SKILL.md's E3.2 checks). Express brokers are exempt.

knownSemantics: RDS DB engine entering extended support. Additional per-vCPU-hour charges apply. Auto-minor-version upgrades continue; major version upgrade requires customer action to exit extended support.
notes: If auto-upgrade is involved, reclassify as BREAKING_CHANGE.

knownSemantics: RDS security patching. DB instance will be restarted during the maintenance window.
Lambda runtime deprecation. After the deprecation date, create and update operations are blocked. Existing functions continue running but receive no security patches.
notes: Use the earliest enforcement date (when create/update is blocked), not the later invocation-block date.

knownSemantics: ElastiCache service update available. May include security fixes or performance improvements.
notes: If the update description mentions only bug fixes or features (no CVE), use INFORMATIONAL.

knownSemantics: AWS Shield Advanced subscription renewal confirmation. No customer action required.
Active EC2 operational issue. May indicate an ongoing regional disruption.
notes: Check statusCode. If closed/resolved, reclassify as INFORMATIONAL.

knownSemantics: Amazon Keyspaces is rotating its TLS certificate. Applications trusting the old root CA may lose connectivity.
notes: Confirmed impact depends on the application trust store, not on the table list AWS provides. Use get_event_type_guidance + get_affected_entities together.

knownSemantics: RDS is rotating its CA certificate. Client connections trusting only the old root CA may lose connectivity after the rotation date.
notes: Confirmed impact depends on the client application's trust store, not on the DB instance list AWS provides.

knownSemantics: DocumentDB is rotating its CA certificate. Client connections trusting only the old root CA may lose connectivity after the rotation date.
notes: Confirmed impact depends on the client application's trust store, not on the cluster list AWS provides.

knownSemantics: A service endpoint is deprecating TLS 1.0/1.1. Clients that cannot negotiate TLS 1.2+ will lose connectivity after the deadline.
notes: Confirmed impact depends on each caller's negotiated TLS version and SDK/runtime, not on the listed endpoint.
